title: Limited average versus future discounted reward
description: Explores the trade-off between limited average reward and future discounted reward in reinforcement learning settings.

title: Shapley Value in Coalition Games
description: An introduction to Shapley values and their role in fairly distributing payoffs among players in coalition games.

title: Mixed vs Behavioral Strategies
description: Covers the distinction between mixed and behavioral strategies in game theory with illustrative examples.

title: Intro to finite and infinite repeated games
description: Introduction to the structure and equilibria of finite and infinite repeated games in game theory.

title: Introduction to repeated prisoner dilemma
description: Discusses the repeated prisoner's dilemma, cooperation strategies, and equilibrium outcomes over multiple rounds.

title: Application of Coalitional Games
description: Real-world applications of coalitional game theory across networks, economics, and multi-agent systems.

title: Applications of game theory in Machine Learning, Economics and Geopolitics
description: Surveys how game theory informs machine learning models, economic policy, and geopolitical strategy.

title: Introduction to Stochastic Games and Learning
description: An overview of stochastic games and how learning algorithms behave in dynamic, probabilistic environments.

title: Bayesian Games
description: Introduction to Bayesian games where players have incomplete information about other players' types.

title: Transferable Utility Cooperative Games
description: Covers cooperative games with transferable utility, including core concepts, stability, and allocation rules.

title: Folk Theorems in Game Theory
description: Explains folk theorems and how they characterize the set of achievable payoffs in infinitely repeated games.

title: Ex Ante Interim Bayesian Nash Equilibrium
description: Deep dive into ex ante and interim Bayesian Nash equilibrium concepts in games of incomplete information.
